title: Purple Oni Character Poses
description: Four sequential views of a stylized purple and white oni-like character with horns, skull motifs, and flowing purple energy effects. The figure is shown in dynamic martial arts stances across the panels, from a ready pose to a powerful energy burst with purple splashes emanating from its back.
prompt: A four-panel character turn-around of a fierce Japanese-inspired oni demon warrior with white skeletal face paint, black horns, wild white hair, wearing purple and white traditional garments with skull and spiral patterns, black clawed gauntlets and boots, shown in multiple dynamic fighting stances including a powerful pose with explosive purple energy bursting from its back, clean studio lighting on gray background, stylized digital illustration
